name: dai-cg-priv5
command: exec > /out/cg-priv5.txt 2>&1; echo '== procs in nsroot before =='; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cgroup.procs; echo; echo '== move all to keeper =='; mkdir /sys/fs/cgroup/keeper; for p in $(cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cgroup.procs); do echo $p > /sys/fs/cgroup/keeper/cgroup.procs 2>/dev/null; done; echo 'procs left:'; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cgroup.procs | head; echo; echo '== enable at nsroot now =='; (echo '+cpu +memory +pids' > /sys/fs/cgroup/cgroup.subtree_control) 2>&1; echo rc=$?; echo '-- subtree_control:'; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cgroup.subtree_control; echo; echo '== mkdir s3 + controllers =='; mkdir /sys/fs/cgroup/s3; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/s3/cgroup.controllers | head -3; ls /sys/fs/cgroup/s3/ | grep -E 'max|weight' | head; echo; echo '== limits =='; (echo max > /sys/fs/cgroup/s3/memory.max) 2>&1; echo "mem rc=$?"; (echo 100 > /sys/fs/cgroup/s3/pids.max) 2>&1; echo "pids rc=$?"; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/s3/memory.max /sys/fs/cgroup/s3/pids.max 2>/dev/null; echo; echo '== move test proc =='; sleep 300 & SP=$!; sleep 1; (echo $SP > /sys/fs/cgroup/s3/cgroup.procs) 2>&1; echo "move rc=$?"; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/s3/cgroup.procs 2>/dev/null; kill $SP 2>/dev/null; echo done
